## Objective
New version of lymphocyte feature extraction that is faster (does not calculate clusters)
and more stable (allows multiple tries of reading in files)

## Issues / Deviations / Comments
The first 658 mucosal segments were initially processed with a previous (slow) version that also generated lymphocyte clusters (commented out here). 
This step was skipped in this iteration (since the resulting feature was dropped after feature exploration). The processed segments were not reprocessed, just filtered to match the others. 
```{r, libraries, directories and functions}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(nngeo)
Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0) #problem opening large file w/o this

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
#to_box <- "C:/Users/15303/Box/"

read_sf_retry <- function(path, retries = 3, wait = 5) {
  attempt <- 1
  while (attempt <= retries) {
    msg <- sprintf("  ↳ trying to open %s (attempt %d/%d)…", basename(path),
                   attempt, retries)
    cat(msg, "\n")

    x <- tryCatch(
      st_read(path, quiet = TRUE) |> st_set_crs(0),
      error = function(e) NULL            # swallow the error, return NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(x)) return(x)            # success → return the object

    Sys.sleep(wait)                       # wait a bit and try again
    attempt <- attempt + 1
  }
  stop("failed")                          # let caller know it never worked
}


#Calculates the distance to closest neighbor, and the distance to the villi/crypts junction
calculate_lymphocyte_distances <- function(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocytes, pixel_length_um, dup_threshold_um = 0.2) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(nngeo)
  
  #Find and drop duplicate lymphocytes
  threshold_px <- dup_threshold_um / pixel_length_um
  
  lymphocyte_centroids <- lymphocytes %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_centroid(geometry))
  
  dup_lists <- st_is_within_distance(lymphocyte_centroids,
                                     lymphocyte_centroids,
                                     dist = threshold_px)
  
  to_drop <- logical(nrow(lymphocyte_centroids))
  for (i in seq_along(dup_lists)) {
    idx <- dup_lists[[i]]
    idx <- idx[idx != i]        # remove self
    to_drop[idx[idx > i]] <- TRUE  # keep deterministic first, drop later ones
  }
  lc_dedup <- lymphocyte_centroids[!to_drop, ]
  

  villi <- mapped_to_mucosa %>% 
    filter(classification == "villi")
  
  crypts <- mapped_to_mucosa %>% 
    filter(classification == "crypts")

  junction <- st_intersection(
    st_boundary(st_union(villi)),
    st_boundary(st_union(crypts))
  ) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    rename(geometry = x)
  

  lymphocyte_distances <- lc_dedup %>%
    mutate(
      closest_junction_px = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, junction)),
      closest_junction_um = closest_junction_px * pixel_length_um
    ) %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    lapply(function(group) {
      if (nrow(group) < 2) {
        # Not enough points for nearest neighbor
        group$closest_neighbor_px <- NA_real_
        group$closest_neighbor_um <- NA_real_
      } else {
        # Safe k = 2, self = FALSE ensures the closest *other* neighbor
        nearest_neighbor <- st_nn(group, group, k = 2, returnDist = TRUE)
        # Take the second  neighbor's distance (skip self)
        closest_neighbor_pxs <- sapply(nearest_neighbor$dist, `[`, 2)
        group$closest_neighbor_px <- closest_neighbor_pxs
        group$closest_neighbor_um <- closest_neighbor_pxs * pixel_length_um
      }
      return(group)
    }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(
      log_closest_junction_um = log10(closest_junction_um + 1),
      log_closest_neighbor_um = log10(closest_neighbor_um + 1)
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()

  return(lymphocyte_distances)
}

summarize_lymphocyte_features <- function(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_distances, pixel_area_um2) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(sf)
  
  expected_area_vars <- c(
  "crypts_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2", 
  "villi_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "villi_lamina_propria_area_um2")
  
  add_missing_area_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  
  #Calculate compartment areas per layer and epithelium crypts ratio
  areas_summary <- mapped_to_mucosa %>%
    filter(classification %in% c("villi_epithelium", "villi_lamina_propria", "crypts_epithelium", "crypts_lamina_propria")) %>%
    mutate(
      area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
      area_um2 = as.numeric(area_px2) * pixel_area_um2  # ensure numeric for pivoting
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, classification, area_um2) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste0(classification, "_area_um2")) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classification,
      values_from = area_um2
    ) %>%
    add_missing_area_vars(expected_area_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / 1000,
      crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = villi_epithelium_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = villi_lamina_propria_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = villi_epithelium_area_um2 / villi_lamina_propria_area_um2,
      crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2
    )

  # Summarize lymphocyte size and distances 
  
  expected_lymphocyte_vars <- c(
  "classification", "measured_area_um2", "closest_junction_um", "closest_neighbor_um",
  "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um")
  
  add_missing_lymphocyte_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
 
  
  lymphocytes_summary <- lymphocyte_distances %>%
    add_missing_lymphocyte_vars(expected_lymphocyte_vars) %>%
    select(all_of(expected_lymphocyte_vars)) %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    summarise(
      count = n(),
      
      mean_log_closest_neighbor_um = mean(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log_closest_neighbor_um = sd(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_neighbor_um = median(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_measured_area_um2 = mean(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_measured_area_um2 = sd(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      
      mean_log_closest_junction_um = mean(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log_closest_junction_um = sd(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_closest_junction_um = median(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_log_closest_junction_um = IQR(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
      ) %>% 
    
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = classification,
      values_from =  everything(), 
      names_glue = "{classification}_{.value}"
    )
  
  expected_cluster_vars <- c(
  "classification", "cluster_n_lymphocytes", "closest_junction_um", "closest_neighbor_um",
  "log_cluster_n_lymphocytes", "log_closest_junction_um", "log_closest_neighbor_um")
  
  add_missing_cluster_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  

  # # Summarize lymphocyte clusters size and distances
  # lymphocyte_clusters_summary <- lymphocyte_cluster_distances %>%
  #   add_missing_cluster_vars(expected_cluster_vars) %>%
  #   select(all_of(expected_cluster_vars)) %>%
  #   group_by(classification) %>%
  #   summarise(
  #     count = n(),
  #     median_cluster_n_lymphocytes = median(cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_cluster_n_lymphocytes = IQR(cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     median_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = median(log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes = IQR(log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     median_closest_junction_um = median(closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_closest_junction_um = IQR(closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     median_log_closest_junction_um = median(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_log_closest_junction_um = IQR(log_closest_junction_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     median_closest_neighbor_um = median(closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     median_log_closest_neighbor_um = median(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um = IQR(log_closest_neighbor_um, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   ) %>%
  #   pivot_wider(
  #     names_from = classification,
  #     values_from = c(
  #       count,
  #       median_cluster_n_lymphocytes, iqr_cluster_n_lymphocytes,
  #       median_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes, iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes,
  #       median_closest_junction_um, iqr_closest_junction_um,
  #       median_log_closest_junction_um, iqr_log_closest_junction_um,
  #       median_closest_neighbor_um, iqr_closest_neighbor_um,
  #       median_log_closest_neighbor_um, iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um
  #     ),
  #     names_glue = "{classification}_{.value}"
  #   )
  
  
  expected_vars <- c(
  "crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count", "crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2",
  "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count", "crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2",
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count", "villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2",
  "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count", "villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2")
  
  add_missing_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
        df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }
  
  # combine summarys and add area normalized counts
  summary <- bind_cols(areas_summary, lymphocytes_summary) %>%
    add_missing_vars(expected_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2,
      villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
        villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2)
  
  global_measured_area_summary <- lymphocyte_distances %>%
  summarise(
    mean_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2 = mean(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lymphocytes_measured_area_um2 = sd(measured_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  # Add to summary
  summary <- bind_cols(summary, global_measured_area_summary)
  
  return(summary)
}


#helper function for frames with no lymphocytes
add_blank_lymphocyte_summary <- function(mapped_to_mucosa,
                                         pixel_area_um2,
                                         image_name,
                                         fragment_name,
                                         mucosa_name) {
  
  expected_area_vars <- c(
  "crypts_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2", 
  "villi_epithelium_area_um2", 
  "villi_lamina_propria_area_um2")
  
  add_missing_area_vars <- function(df, vars) {
    for (v in vars) {
      if (!v %in% names(df)) {
      df[[v]] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
    df
  }

  # ---- 1) calculate the four compartment areas (+ 1000 µm² & ratios) ----
  areas <- mapped_to_mucosa %>%
    filter(classification %in%
             c("villi_epithelium", "villi_lamina_propria",
               "crypts_epithelium", "crypts_lamina_propria")) 
  if(nrow(areas) == 0){
    areas <- data.frame(
      image_name = image_name,
      fragment_name = fragment_name,
      mucosa_name = mucosa_name,
      crypts_epithelium_area_um2 = 0,
      crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2 = 0,
      villi_epithelium_area_um2 = 0,
      villi_lamina_propria_area_um2 = 0,
      crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = 0,
      crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = 0,
      villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2 = 0,
      villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2 = 0,
      villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = NA_real_,
      crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = NA_real_)
  } else{
    areas <- areas %>%
    mutate(area_um2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) * pixel_area_um2) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name,
           classification, area_um2) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste0(classification, "_area_um2")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = classification,
                values_from = area_um2) %>%
    add_missing_area_vars(expected_area_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2      = crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / 1000,
      crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2  = crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2 / 1000,
      villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2       = villi_epithelium_area_um2    / 1000,
      villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2   = villi_lamina_propria_area_um2/ 1000,
      villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio =
        villi_epithelium_area_um2 / villi_lamina_propria_area_um2,
      crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio =
        crypts_epithelium_area_um2 / crypts_lamina_propria_area_um2)}
  
  
  # ---- 2) zero-filled count/cluster columns ------------------------------
  zeros <- tibble(
    crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count             = 0,
    crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count         = 0,
    villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count              = 0,
    villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count          = 0)

  # ---- 3) combine and derive per-area rates ------------------------------
  summary_row <- bind_cols(areas, zeros) %>%
    mutate(
      crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 =
        crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / crypts_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 =
        crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / crypts_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2,
      villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 =
        villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_count / villi_epithelium_area_1000_um2,
      villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 =
        villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_count / villi_lamina_propria_area_1000_um2)

 return(summary_row)
}
```

```{r}

for (img_frag_muc in image_fragment_mucosa_names[start:stop]){
  
  message("Processing ", img_frag_muc)
  
  tryCatch({
  
    parts <- str_split(img_frag_muc, "_")[[1]]
    
    muc  <- parts[length(parts)]
    frag <- parts[length(parts) - 1]
    img <- paste(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_")
    
    mucosa_info <- mucosa_list %>% filter(name == img_frag_muc)
    pixel_length_um <- mucosa_info$pixel_length_um
    pixel_area_um2 <- mucosa_info$pixel_area_um2
    
    mapped_to_mucosa_path  <- paste0(map_to_mucosa_dir, img_frag_muc, "_", model_version, "_mapped_to_mucosa.geojson")
    mapped_to_mucosa <- read_sf_retry(mapped_to_mucosa_path) %>%
      mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
             area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2)
    
    lymphocytes_path <- paste0(map_to_mucosa_dir, img_frag_muc, "_", model_version, "_mapped_to_mucosa_lymphocytes.geojson")
    
    lymphocytes <- read_sf_retry(lymphocytes_path)
    
    print(paste0("nrow lymphocytes is: ", nrow(lymphocytes)))
    
    if(nrow(lymphocytes) == 0) {
      print(paste0("nrow lymphocytes is: ", nrow(lymphocytes), " for segment ", img_frag_muc, 
                   " printing empty row and skipping to next"))
      summary_row <-  add_blank_lymphocyte_summary(mapped_to_mucosa, 
                                                  pixel_area_um2, 
                                                  img,
                                                  frag,
                                                  muc)
      lymphocyte_features_summaries <- bind_rows(lymphocyte_features_summaries, summary_row)
      
      next
    } 
    
    #calculate distance to closest neighbor for lymphocytes
    lymphocyte_distances <- calculate_lymphocyte_distances(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocytes, pixel_length_um)
    
    lymphocytes <- lymphocytes %>% filter(name %in% lymphocyte_distances$name)
    
    
    write_json(lymphocyte_distances, paste0(features_dir, "/lymphocyte_distances/", img_frag_muc, "_lymphocyte_distances.json"), pretty = TRUE)
    
    lymphocyte_features_summary <- summarize_lymphocyte_features(mapped_to_mucosa, lymphocyte_distances, pixel_area_um2)
    
    lymphocyte_features_summaries <- bind_rows(lymphocyte_features_summaries, lymphocyte_features_summary) 
    
    write_json(lymphocyte_features_summaries, paste0(features_dir, "feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_", subset_name, "_",  start, "_", stop, "json"), pretty = TRUE)
    
    }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed to process: ", img_frag_muc, " with error: ", e$message)
    error_log[[img_frag_muc]] <<- e$message
  })
} 
  
write_json(lymphocyte_features_summaries, paste0(features_dir, "feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_", subset_name, "_",  start, "_", stop, ".json"), pretty = TRUE)

write_json(error_log, paste0(features_dir, "feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summary_errors_", subset_name, "_",  start, "_", stop, ".json"), pretty = TRUE)
```
